firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: an 8-word h1 with the trade, the city and the outcome; a four-segment dial with Fall filled; one primary action and a quieter call button; the brass band peeks in. 390-first.jpg: the ghost arc behind the h1 is gone, the h1 is 3 lines, and both actions plus the sticky Call / Price bar are above the fold. Held at 9 because about 60px of dead fog sits under the buttons at 1440 and the hero meta line is a mono middle-dot string.

distinctiveness.notes: Both template grids are gone. 1440-full.jpg: the services are now a four-quarter season ledger (Spring Mar-May ... Winter Dec-Feb, each column under its quarter icon) with an All-year strip and the dial above. 1440-scroll-75.jpg: the reviews sit around a central 'One house, four seasons' ring, with one quote per quarter on its clock position. The dial now does the work from the cover to the footer. Not higher: the white 'All year' box under the ledger is still a generic card.

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: a tight display serif with real scale contrast. The season ledger heads (Spring / Summer / Fall / Winter) are set in serif at a good size (1440-full.jpg). Not higher: mono is still on every dateline, chip, range and review label, and the hero has a mono middle-dot meta string (1440-first.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the tonal rhythm holds (deep / brass / paper / slate / photo break / paper / deep / paper / white / deep / paper / deep). The services ledger closes the earlier dead band, and the reviews ring gives the white band a centre of gravity (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Minor: the Fall and Winter ledger columns end after one job, which leaves a ragged empty bottom-right before the All-year box (1440-full.jpg).

photo.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: one warm sepia grade still runs across the set. Unchanged since round 4: the spring figure is a macro of microfiber cloth, not pollen, a porch or a screen (1440-full.jpg), and the cabin bath is a flat flash snapshot with a toilet in the foreground (1440-scroll-50.jpg). That is stock at its floor.

copy.notes: 1440-scroll-75.jpg: the Ruby H. duplicate is solved by a pointer card ('Her note sits with the August page'), and the reviews now follow the year as the heading promises. 'Nine jobs, each tagged with its season' is true: 2+1+1+1+4 (1440-full.jpg). Every claim checks against facts.json (rating, 13 years, guarantee, license, insured), and every rating, price and review is labelled Sample. Not higher: the pointer card stands where a quote should be, which reads as a gap in a review grid.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: clean hero, with no arc behind the h1. 390-full.jpg: the ledger stacks by season and the All-year rows put 'Price this' on the right of each title, so the run of 9 jobs is now grouped into 5 headed blocks. The reviews stack in year order with the small ring beside the heading. render.json shows no overflow at 320 or 390. Not higher: the page is about 13,000px tall at 390.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg / 390-rm-full.jpg: every word is visible in reduced motion, and the review ring is drawn complete. The hero text sits on a dark scrim (1440-first.jpg). Every review, rating and price carries a Sample label (1440-scroll-75.jpg). render.json shows no errors. The ledger 'Price this' links are text-sized; they pass, but only just, as tap targets on 390-full.jpg.

motion.notes: The signature now moves in more places. 1440-scroll-25.jpg / 1440-scroll-50.jpg: the sticky dial turns and relabels SUMMER -> WINTER -> ALL YEAR (1440-scroll-75.jpg). 1440-scroll-75.jpg: the review ring fills by quarter as you scroll (two quarters filled on screen, while 1440-rm-full.jpg shows all four), and the services dial shows a hand mid-sweep in 1440-full.jpg. Not higher: the hero dial does not visibly hand off to the sticky corner dial, and the spreads still enter with plain reveals.

wow.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: the countdown ring tool (20 DAYS OUT, book-by / deep-clean / touch-up ticks) is still the one interactive moment, and it covers only the fall holidays. The concept's Season Planner (a 12-month strip with add-ons that prefills the form) is not on screen. The ledger and the review ring make the year legible, but neither is a tool.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the duplicated quote and the 390 ghost arc (390-first.jpg) are gone, and the footer closes with the dial. Left: the ragged ledger column ends (1440-full.jpg) and the white All-year card sits on a paper band like a pasted-in box.

elevate.move: Build the promised Season Planner as the page's centrepiece. Pick a frequency and a starting month, and the dial unrolls into a 12-month strip with each month's add-on (pollen clean in April, mildew in August, guest prep in November, cabin airing in January) and its Sample price. The selection is carried into the four-question form, so the almanac turns into the visitor's own year.

Re-cast the season figures so each one shows its season's mess or its result, not a generic object. Use a pollen-dusted sill, porch rail or screen for spring, and a warm daylight interior with wood and quilts for the winter cabin in place of the flash toilet-and-tub snapshot. Crop all four to the same arch so they read as plates in one almanac.
